resources.string: Use at least 10 characters, and not only digits.
Use more than digits: a PIN is not allowed.
That is longer than any passphrase can be (the limit is 1,024 characters).
%1$s encrypts everything it stores on this phone. Your passphrase unlocks it each time you open the app; without it nothing can be read.
A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered. There is no reset link and no recovery key: the only way back in is to reset the app, which deletes all of its data.
Too many wrong attempts. Try again in %1$s.
Too many wrong attempts. Wait a while, then try again.

This deletes everything %1$s has stored on this phone: every chat, every setting, your passphrase and fingerprint unlock. There is no recovery key and no way to get the data back. The app then starts again with first-time set-up.
Some of the app\'s keys could not be deleted from the phone\'s key store. The app tries again every time it starts.
Some of the app\'s files could not be deleted. Reset again to retry.
The lock configuration could not be deleted. Reset again to retry.
The app\'s data cannot be unlocked
The lock configuration is damaged, so the key that encrypts the app\'s data cannot be recovered.
Encrypted data exists, but its lock configuration is gone, so it cannot be decrypted.
A key in the phone\'s secure key store that the app\'s data depends on is gone or unusable (for example after the key store was cleared).
There is no recovery key. To use the app again, reset its data. Try again first if you think the problem is temporary.
Nothing has been deleted. Try again; if it keeps failing, resetting the app\'s data is the only other way on.
Fingerprint unlock did not work and was turned off. Use your passphrase.
Fingerprint unlock is not available right now. Use your passphrase; fingerprint unlock stays on.
Too many fingerprint attempts. Use your passphrase.
Fingerprint unlock was not turned on.
Fingerprint unlock was turned off because no fingerprint is enrolled any more. Use your passphrase.
Your fingerprint can unlock the app instead of the passphrase. The passphrase always works too, and is still needed after the fingerprints on this phone change.
Fingerprint unlock was turned off because the fingerprints on this phone changed, or its key became unusable. Your passphrase still works.
Your fingerprint unlocks the encryption key through the phone\'s secure hardware. Turning this on or off needs your passphrase.
No strong fingerprint (or other Class 3 biometric) is set up on this phone.
Time in the background before the app locks. It is always locked after a restart.
Screenshots and screen recordings are blocked.
On until %1$s. It also ends when the screen turns off or the app is closed. While it is on, screenshots and screen recordings can capture your chats; the preview in the app switcher stays hidden.
Needs Android 13 or later. On this version of Android the preview in the app switcher cannot be hidden by itself, so screenshots stay blocked.
Screenshots could not be allowed: the phone did not let the app watch for the screen turning off.
The app\'s content is always hidden in the app switcher, and the keyboard is always asked not to learn from what you type.
Deletes every chat and setting and your passphrase, then starts again with first-time set-up.
That did not work: the phone\'s key store or storage reported an error.
Enter your passphrase to turn on fingerprint unlock.
Enter your passphrase to turn off fingerprint unlock.
A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered.
Too much time has passed. Enter your passphrase again.
The file as it was has been kept.
A general assistant that speaks many languages. The most capable model here.
Answers questions about the Second World War from memory. Not a general assistant.
A very small chat model for everyday questions. Fluent, but often wrong on facts.
A small chat model that is still being trained.
Unavailable while an answer is being written
No chats yet. A chat appears here with its first message.
“%1$s” will be deleted from this phone. This cannot be undone.
This chat will be deleted from this phone. This cannot be undone.
This chat\'s model is not in this build
%1$s is not part of this build of the app. Choose another model to carry on with this chat.
No model file is part of this build of the app, so messages cannot be answered. Chats that are already here can still be read.
%1$s answers on this phone. Nothing you write leaves it.
This app uses AI, and AI can make mistakes.

No app on this phone could open that link.

Each model has its own settings. Changes are saved as you type and apply from the next answer.
Given to the model at the start of every conversation, before your first message.
